trends.whatProductOffers: An ILAS that allocates the single premium, after an upfront charge, to notional units of SFC-authorised investment options, so policy value follows the performance of the selected options.

keyFigures.label: Investment options
keyFigures.condition: Under the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds

keyFigures.label: Upfront charge
keyFigures.condition: 6.75% in total of the single premium

exclusionsOrConditions: Principal is at risk and subject to AIA's credit risk.
Returns are lower than the return of the corresponding underlying funds because of fees and charges.
The extract does not name the available funds or their risk profiles.
An 8-year holding period is indicated; the plan is not suitable for shorter horizons.

trends.whatProductOffers: The client can switch between investment options over time to suit changes in investment plan and risk profile, and can make partial withdrawals subject to conditions.

keyFigures.label: Investment options
keyFigures.condition: Listed in the investment options brochure

exclusionsOrConditions: Partial withdrawals reduce the death benefit and the amount of any loyalty bonus.
Partial withdrawals may affect the sustainability of the policy because the account value falls.
Early surrender in the first 5 policy years carries a surrender charge of up to 6% of the single premium.
Switching fees or limits are not stated in the extract.

trends.whatProductOffers: On death on or before the policy anniversary following the insured's 80th birthday, the plan pays the higher of 100% of the single premium less partial withdrawals, or 105% of the account value; after that date it pays 105% of the account value.

keyFigures.label: Death benefit before age 80
keyFigures.value: Higher of 100% of single premium less withdrawals, or 105% of account value

exclusionsOrConditions: Life protection is low by design.
Cost of insurance is deducted from the policy and may increase significantly as the insured ages or if investments lose value.
A named and surviving contingent insured who becomes the new insured changes the death benefit position.
Partial withdrawals reduce the death benefit.
